experiments.study_type: Bone fracture model and lineage tracing
experiments.procedure_text: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice using a 3-point bending device following intramedullary canal stabilization.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice. ... A 0.5-mm-diameter needle was inserted into the intramedullary canal to stabilize the impending fracture. After the incision was sutured, a closed fracture was produced at the midshaft of the right femur using a custom-made 3-point bending device
experiments.test_system_evidence: Bone fractures were generated on the right femurs of adult male mice.
experiments.route_evidence: Mice were anesthetized by an intraperitoneal injection of 40 mg kg -1 sodium pentobarbital

endpoints.label: bone fracture healing
endpoints.evidence: Prrx1 + cells are required for bone fracture and skin wound healing.

substances.name: sodium pentobarbital
substances.evidence: anesthetized by an intraperitoneal injection of 40 mg kg -1 sodium pentobarbital

experiments.procedure_text: Circular wounds of 10 mm in diameter and the full thickness of the skin were produced through the panniculus carnosus on the dorsum.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Circular wounds of 10 mm in diameter and the full thickness of the skin were produced through the panniculus carnosus on the dorsum
